scientific_integrity: The fixed-rank infinite-dimensional limits are argued analytically using exterior powers and Gram determinants. Finite numerical checks corroborate only; no independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed rank, fixed positive exponential parameter, and fixed strict dilation; not uniform in rank or dilation. Older general prediction or exterior-power theory may cover the constants and historical priority is not independently established.
title: Bessel–Toeplitz singular-jet law for exponential Hardy composition iterates
